brief:
I need an assistant that answers HR policy questions for our shore staff in the Kochi
and Mumbai offices: leave, travel bookings and expense claims, and conduct rules such as
gifts, remote work and how to raise a grievance. It should also tell each employee how
many leave days they have left this year.

documents.title: Code of Conduct and Grievance Procedure

questions.question: Is the assistant intended for use by all shore staff or only specific roles?
questions.why: Determines the scope of the assistant and who needs access.

questions.question: Should the assistant be able to handle real-time data or computations?
questions.why: Decides if live data or computation is needed, e.g., today's date, weather.
questions.default_answer: No, it should not handle real-time data or computations.

questions.question: Are there specific HR policies that must be refused or not followed by the assistant?
questions.why: Identifies policies that the assistant must not support.

questions.question: Should the assistant provide information on remote work policies?
questions.why: Determines if remote work policies are part of the assistant's scope.
questions.default_answer: Yes, it should include remote work policies.

questions.question: Is there a need for the assistant to look up table rows or specific data from the documents?
questions.why: Decides if the assistant needs to reference specific data from the documents.
questions.default_answer: No, it should not look up table rows or specific data.
